instruction.text: Spell the word correctly by adding the suffix to the word ending in -y.

hint.text: When adding suffixes to words ending in -y, the general rule is to change y to i, except when using the suffix -ing. However, there are sometimes exceptions to this rule, where the -y should be kept.
